notes.title: NON VR Mode is here! and First Person story on the way.
notes.content:
Thanks to so many requests and feedback we have now added the ability to play without VR in "Non-VR Mode". Just select Non-VR from the starting menu with no VR equipment enabled before you play. Gamepad Required.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/45c5d2_82a3f19b621d4e80bf18f2d794449ba9~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_600,h_186,al_c,q_80/45c5d2_82a3f19b621d4e80bf18f2d794449ba9~mv2.webp[/img]

Small warning, do not attempt to play Non-VR mode with VR equipment, the results will not be fun at all!

In other news we have started adding a first person story line that will be available in a future update using full motion tracked control and room scale. We would like to keep the game evolving in many different directions so your feedback has been invaluable. Thank you for the support.

notes.title: First Major Update
notes.content: Thanks for playing and enjoying so far everyone. There were some previous issues with Lighting, Animation and Overall quality settings on some computers with the last version, many of them we were unaware of until now. This update should see major improvements in every area including some other minor fixes. Thanks for the great feedback also.
